articles.description: miliq.news روسيا تهدد: أقمار ستارلينك ستتساقط مثل الألعاب روسيا تهدد: أقمار ستارلينك ستتساقط مثل الألعاب بغداد- ميل أكد نائب رئيس مجلس الأمن الروسي دميتري مدفيديف، أن حجب نظام "راسفيت" الروسي للأقمار الصناعية سيؤدي إلى حرب فضائية شاملة. وكتب مدفيديف على منصة "تلغرام"، "حجب نظام (راسفيت) الروسي للأقمار الصناعية بناء على طلب أحمق من كييف يعني تدميرها فقط. وسوف يؤدي ذلك إلى حرب فضائية شاملة. آمل أن يفهم الأمريكيون ذلك. حينها ستسقط أقمار"ستارلينك الاصطناعية ذات المدار المنخفض مثل الألعاب من شجرة عيد الميلاد الذابلة". وصرح زيلينسكي في وقت سابق في مقابلة مع صحيفة "فايننشال تايمز" بأنه طلب مرارا من الرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب حجب نظام "راسفيت" وفرض عقوبات على شركات روسية وصينية تشارك في تطوير النظام . ووفقاً لزيلينسكي، فإن الصين تتعاون مع روسيا في هذا المشروع . وقد أثار ظهور نظير "ستارلينك" لدى روسيا قلقا شديدا في أوكرانيا. ويعتبر مستشار زيلينسكي سيرغي بيسكريستنوف (فليش) أن القوات المسلحة الروسية ستحصل بهذه الطريقة على ميزة خاصة، إذ تستطيع مهاجمة أي أهداف لنظام كييف بمسيّرات موجهة بالأقمار الاصطناعية، في حين أن نظام الاتصالات الأمريكي "ستارلينك" لا يعمل فوق الأراضي الروسية . وتجدر الإشارة إلى أن نظام "راسفيت" من ابتكار شركة "مكتب 1440" الروسية الخاصة العاملة في مجال الصناعات الفضائية، والتي تأسست في ديسمبر 2020 في موسكو، وهي جزء من مجموعة "إكس هولدينغ". وصمم نظام "راسفيت" للأقمار الصناعية الموجودة في المدار الأرضي المنخفض، بهدف توفير نقل بيانات عريض النطاق إلى أي مكان على سطح الأرض. ويجري تطوير النظام في إطار المشروع الوطني "اقتصاد البيانات والتحول الرقمي للدولة" خلال الفترة 2025-2030 . يذكر أن الشركة أطلقت بنجاح في نهاية مارس أول 16 قمرا صناعيا ضمن مجموعة "راسفيت" إلى المدار الأرضي المنخفض. جميع الحقوق محفوظة (ميل نيوز)

Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – ORA Iraq awarded CRC Dorra the building contract for the first phase of Madinat Al Ward, paving the way for large-scale development in Iraq. The deal was signed in the presence of Naguib Sawiris, Chairman of ORA, and Mohamed Dorra, Vice Chairman of Dorra Group, as the project progressed from ground preparation to primary construction. CRC Dorra will begin construction after POWERCHINA has completed the earthworks and ground preparation for Phase One, according to ORA Iraq. The deal adds another important regional contractor to the development. CRC Dorra is the contracting arm of Dorra Group, an engineering and construction business founded in 1943 that operates in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and Iraq. Its work includes residential, commercial, office, and hotel developments, as well as design-build projects. ORA said that the selection was based on CRC Dorra’s construction expertise and capacity to perform large-scale projects. The commencement of construction marks a key milestone for Madinat Al Ward as ORA expands its investment and development efforts in the Iraqi market. The company said that it continues to be dedicated to building the project as an integrated community, with the new contract advancing Phase One from site preparation to physical construction.

articles.description: Iraqi FM Fuad Hussein confirmed US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent agreed to exempt religious pilgrimage flights to Iraqi holy shrines from sanctions on Iran. Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Minister of Foreign Affairs Fuad Hussein announced on Friday, October 2, 2026, that U.S. Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent has agreed to exempt religious pilgrimage flights to holy sites in Iraq from secondary sanctions imposed on Iranian aviation, following intensive bilateral talks held in Washington. The decision resolves mounting diplomatic friction surrounding the status of Najaf International Airport, granting legal clarity for passenger arrivals while shielding Iraqi aviation infrastructure from punitive measures. In a statement shared on X (formerly Twitter) and reported by the 964 Network, Hussein outlined that discussions with Bessent encompassed the overarching trajectory of U.S.-Iraqi economic and security ties, regional fiscal stability, and the spillover impacts of American sanctions enforcement on the domestic Iraqi economy. Hussein specifically raised the operational paralysis facing Najaf International Airport—a vital national transport hub serving millions of international religious pilgrims annually—emphasizing that economic restrictions should not impede lawful civilian travel or religious observances. Secretary Bessent acknowledged Iraq’s sovereign concerns, formally approving a targeted waiver for flights directed toward the holy shrines. During the diplomatic session, Hussein reaffirmed Baghdad’s appreciation for past U.S. and International Coalition support in the campaign to defeat Daesh (ISIS), while reiterating the federal government’s constitutional roadmap under Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi to monopolize arms under the state and maintain sole authority over war and peace. Commending Washington’s accommodation, Hussein noted that recognizing the importance of religious freedom and facilitating pilgrim transit reflects shared values of mutual respect and tolerance, reinforcing a stable, long-term bilateral partnership between Iraq and the United States.

articles.description: The Iraqi oil minister and his Turkish counterpart met in Turkey to finalize a deal for oil flows between Iraq and Turkey through Ceyhan. Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Khudair and Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar during their meeting in Ankara, Turkey. Photo: Iraqi Oil Ministry Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Khudair and Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar met in Turkey to finalize a deal for oil flows between Iraq and Turkey through the Mediterranean port of Ceyhan. Khudair stated on Saturday that the meeting was highly constructive, with discussions centered on increasing export capacity through Ceyhan and Turkish firms’ participation in Iraqi oil and gas projects. The involvement of Turkish companies in Iraq’s energy sector is critical to the governments of both countries, particularly the Iraqi government, according to Khudair. He noted that the step helps attract competent global corporations to develop Iraq’s oil and gas resources. The Iraqi oil minister indicated that two joint technical committees have been formed to develop oilfields and construct oil facility infrastructure. Khudair arrived in the Turkish capital, Ankara, on Friday to discuss cooperation in the fields of oil, gas, and energy. Khudair signed an agreement with Turkey in early August to transport Iraqi crude oil through the Iraq-Turkey pipeline to the port of Ceyhan. The deal stipulates a minimum volume of 750,000 barrels per day for a one-year period, pending the completion of a broader framework agreement. At the time, Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi declared that Iraqi and Turkish enterprises will begin executing the deal to transport crude oil to Ceyhan via the Iraq-Turkey pipeline. Al-Zaidi said that Baghdad and Ankara were working to finalize a framework deal for the oil, electricity, and water resources sectors.

articles.description: Amwaj International launched "Zayouna Gate" in Baghdad, featuring two 36-story residential towers with 524 luxury units, an on-site school, and smart amenities. Baghdad (IraqiNews.com) – Amwaj International officially launched its latest premium residential development, Zayouna Gate, during a launch ceremony hosted on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at the Mövenpick Hotel Baghdad. The event convened business leaders, prominent real estate figures, and investment stakeholders to review the master plan of the large-scale urban project, which aims to expand modern vertical living within eastern Baghdad. Located in the central Zayouna district, the development features two 36-story residential towers accommodating 524 apartments. Units range from two-bedroom and three-bedroom layouts starting at 163 square meters to high-end penthouses on the upper levels. Positioned as a self-sustaining gated community, Zayouna Gate combines luxury housing with civic infrastructure, dedicated green space, and family-oriented amenities. Key components of the development include: An integrated private school serving community residents. Central landscaped gardens and landscaped green spaces. Dedicated children’s play zones and pedestrian walking and jogging circuits. A sports club, fitness gym, and exclusive residents’ social club. Retail promenades, commercial outlets, and day-to-day community services. Structured underground and surface parking for residents and visitors. Smart-home building automation, 24/7 concierge, and integrated surveillance security systems. Amwaj International confirmed that its primary sales center began receiving prospective buyers and prospective residents on Friday, October 2, 2026, to review architectural models, unit configurations, and available inventory. The project marks another expansion in Amwaj’s metropolitan pipeline, advancing master-planned residential communities across Baghdad’s high-density urban corridors.
